name: Human
description: Humans are the most adaptable of all the common races.

name: Dwarf
description: Dwarves are known for their skill in warfare, their ability to withstand physical and magical punishment, their knowledge of the earth's secrets, and their hatred of orcs and goblinoids.

name: Elf
description: Elves are known for their poetry, song, and magical arts, but also for their skill with the bow.

name: Gnome
description: Gnomes are in wide demand as alchemists, inventors, and technicians, though most prefer to remain among their own kind in simple comfort.

name: Half-Elf
description: Half-elves have no lands of their own, though they are welcome in human cities and elven forests.

name: Half-Orc
description: Half-orcs are often feared and mistrusted in civilized lands, but their strength and endurance makes them valuable allies.

name: Halfling
description: Halflings are clever, capable, and resourceful survivors. They are notoriously curious and show a daring that many larger people can't match.
